senses.gloss: धूर्त- + कितव धूर्त- + कितव, m. a professed gambler, Yājñ. 2, 199.
धूर्गत धूर्गत, i. e. धुर्-, adj. being at the head, MBh. 1, 2826.

धुर् धुर् (vb. धृ), f. (m., MBh. 13, 2876).
 1. A yoke, Mṛcch. 63, 10.
 2. A burthen, a load, MBh. 1, 741; 5, 2799.
 3. The fore-part of the pole where the yoke is fixed, MBh. 3, 13310. []
 4. Place of honour, the head, Ragh. 14, 74.

† धूर् धूर्, i. 4, Ātm.
 1. To hurt.
 2. To move.

धुर धुर, i. e. धृ + अ,
 I. m. A yoke, MBh. 7, 3675.
 II. m. and f. धुरा धुरा, A burthen, MBh. 13, 4879; Pañc. 26, 3.
 --Comp.

धुरंधर धुरंधर, i. e. धुर् + अम्-धर,
 1. adj.
 1. Able to bear a burthen, MBh. 3, 12724.
 2. Bearing patiently a burthen, MBh. 5, 1077.
 3. Helping, Hit. i. d. 181.
 II. m.
 1. A beast of burthen, Pañc. ed. orn. i. d. 17.
 2. A chief, MBh. 13, 6275.
 3. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 6, 349.
 4. The name of a Rākṣasa or demon, Rām. 6, 32, 15.
धुरीण धुरीण, i. e. धुर् + ईन, m. A chief, Pañc. 187, 13.

धुर्य धुर् + य (sometimes written धूर्य धूर्य),
 I. adj.
 1. Able to bear a burthen, MBh. 13, 3518.
 2. Being at the head, MBh. 4, 1074.
 3. Best, MBh. 3, 13309.
 II. m. A beast of burthen, Man. 4, 67.
 III. n. The fore-part of the pole, Rām. 6, 92, 7.
 --Comp.

धुर्व् धुर्व् (akin to ध्वृ), i. 1, धार्व, Par.
 1. To bend (ved.).
 2. To hurt
धूर्जटि धूर्जटि (curtailed from धूर्जटिन्), and धूर्जटिन् धूर्जटिन्, i. e. धुर्-जटा + इन्, m. A name of Śiva, MBh. 7, 9621.

धूर्त धूर्त (properly ptcple. pf. pass. of ध्वृ), adj., f. ता, Fraudulent, knavish, a rogue, Pañc. 33, 4.
 2. Gaming at dice, a gamester, Rām. 5, 13, 21.
 --Comp.

धूर्तक धूर्त + क, m.
 1. A cheat, MBh. 5, 1519.
 2. The name of a Nāga or infernal serpent, MBh. 1, 2154.
 --Comp.
धूर्तता धूर्त + ता, f. Shrewdness, Bhartṛ. 2, 19.
धूर्वोढृ धूर्वोढृ, i. e. धुर्-, m. a beast of burthen, Pañc. ed. orn. 4, 7.
धूर्त- + समागम धूर्त- + समागम, m. the assemblage of rogues, title of a drama, Lass. 66, 1.
